description: Established in 2020 by two young cycling commuters, Paul Martichoux and Diego Delamare, who came up with the idea of converting the 12.5 square meters of unused underground parking space into multiple secure spots for two-wheelers.
360Learning is a collaborative learning platform that enables companies to upskill their workforce by empowering internal experts to create, share, and continuously improve online courses together.

AB Tasty is a customer experience optimization platform that helps businesses increase conversions and user engagement through a SaaS suite of tools for A/B testing, website personalization, feature management, push marketing, NPS, and analytics.

Aerospacelab is a Belgian, vertically integrated company specializing in the development, manufacturing, and operation of advanced satellite technologies. It collects and processes geospatial data to deliver actionable intelligence for a wide range of industries.

Airfocus is a modular and strategic product management platform that enables teams to prioritize tasks, build clear roadmaps, and align on strategy through customizable templates and seamless integrations.
Animaj is a next-generation media company that acquires and aggregates YouTube Kids channels and children’s IPs, using AI and data to turn them into engaging, multiplatform franchises.

Apiax is a regulatory technology company that digitizes compliance workflows, providing embedded solutions that help financial institutions navigate complex regulations efficiently and drive business growth.

Arcure is a specialist in artificial intelligence and embedded vision, providing solutions like Blaxtair to improve industrial safety and productivity by detecting pedestrians and obstacles around machinery.

Nonprofits are innovative, hardworking and deserve the best tools out there. AssoConnect is an all-in-one nonprofit software to help nonprofits focus less on admin, and more on their impact. Today, AssoConnect helps 15,000 nonprofits around the world, of all sizes and sectors. Main features: CRM, Membership Management, Online Payment, Communication, Website Builder, Event Management and more.

Ateme is a global leader in video compression and delivery solutions, offering innovative technologies to broadcasters and content providers for efficient and high-quality video streaming experiences.

Believe is a leading digital music company that supports independent artists and labels worldwide through online distribution, marketing, and promotion services, helping them grow their audience and revenue across more than 50 countries.
Bergamotte is an online florist offering fresh, seasonal flower bouquets, plants, and home gifts for delivery, with a focus on quality, creativity, and sustainability.
Bigblue is a fulfillment-as-a-service platform for e-commerce brands, enabling them to scale effortlessly and enhance the customer experience through fast and reliable logistics.

Calixar is a biotechnology company specializing in the isolation and stabilization of fully native, full-length membrane proteins in solution, preserving their structural and functional integrity to support drug discovery and therapeutic development.

Carbonable is a DeFi-powered platform that enables companies and individuals to invest in high-quality carbon offset projects through a marketplace of tokenized assets. By leveraging NFTs backed by stablecoins and offering high yields, Carbonable facilitates sustainable investment and supports global decarbonization efforts.

Chauffeur Privé, now part of FREE NOW, was a French ride-hailing platform offering premium private car services. Integrated into the FREE NOW mobility ecosystem, it contributed to building a unified app that provides users across Europe with access to taxis, private drivers, and micromobility options such as scooters—all within a single, seamless experience.
Citilog specializes in intelligent transportation systems, providing video-based monitoring solutions to improve traffic flow and enhance road safety in urban environments.
Codenvy, now part of Red Hat OpenShift Dev Spaces, offers cloud-based development environments that allow developers to code, build, and test applications collaboratively without local setup.
Coinhouse is a Neo Crypto Bank that enables individuals and institutions to buy, sell, and manage digital assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum, offering secure storage and expert advisory services.

Colette’s mission is perfectly aligned with Mutuelle Impact’s investment thesis: maintain physical and mental health of senior people through increased social interactions and increased revenue. On the one hand, it helps students and young workers to find simple and affordable housing, in better quality and more spacious accommodations, by living with hosts who have a room to rent. On the other hand, it allows hosts to rent out their vacant rooms to young people in complete confidence, and get additional income. Above all, it’s a clever way to break solitude and create links. The offer is based on technology stacks and automation of processes, delivering fluid and transparent matching.

Commanders Act is a marketing data platform that helps large websites—such as retailers, banks, and media companies—collect, structure, and activate customer data without relying on cookies. Its solutions include tag and consent management, as well as a Customer Data Platform, enabling optimized marketing performance and compliance with privacy regulations.

Core Biogenesis is a biotechnology company that uses plants as biofactories to produce cost-efficient recombinant proteins and growth factors for applications in cell therapy—such as treatments for neurodegenerative diseases and cancer—as well as in the development of cultivated meat and skincare.

Currencycloud is a cloud-based payment engine that enables businesses to manage cross-border payments and foreign exchange with ease. Through its API-driven platform, Currencycloud offers real-time currency conversion, multi-currency accounts, and global payment processing, helping financial institutions and fintechs scale international transactions efficiently and transparently.
Dattak provides proactive cyber insurance and cybersecurity services for SMEs, combining risk assessment, continuous monitoring, and comprehensive coverage to protect against cyber threats.

Dealt is a key B2B2C platform that enables businesses to offer white-label services—such as installation, assembly, maintenance, and gardening—through a catalog of over 350 options, helping them enhance customer experience and stand out in the market.

Destia is the French leader in home care. This network of local agencies relies on more than 5,000 caregivers to improve the quality of life of elderly people who are dependent and/or living with disabilities at home. Its motto: “to respect, and even enhance, their autonomy.” This investment is part of the Mutuelles Impact Large Cap fund pocket.

Co-founded in March 2020 by Ivan Voznyuk (PhD in Applied Mathematics) and Dr. Edwin Quarello (KOL obstetrician-gynecologist), Diagnoly is an AI-powered medical screening company that significantly improves ultrasound care through cutting-edge artificial intelligence. Focused on prenatal mother-fetal medicine and women’s health, Diagnoly’s solutions enhance the accuracy of prenatal screening. A winner of the 2020 i-Lab competition, Diagnoly was recognized as a DeepTech company twice (March 2020 and January 2022).

DivRiots is a software company that builds tools to empower front-end teams, enhancing efficiency and collaboration. Its flagship product, Backlight.dev, is a specialized development environment for Design Systems, offering advanced collaborative features for both developers and designers.

Dogami is a mobile-first, blockchain-based game where players adopt, raise, and trade 3D NFT dog avatars. Set in the ‘Petaverse’, the game blends augmented reality and play-to-earn mechanics, allowing users to adopt, play, earn, and socialize with their virtual companions.

Dolead is the world’s first Leads-as-a-Service platform, specializing in generating exclusive, sales-ready leads through AI-driven paid media campaigns. By combining proprietary semantic technology with customer data integration, Dolead delivers scalable and sustainable customer acquisition solutions for businesses.

DynAdmic is a digital video advertising platform that uses proprietary audio recognition technology and programmatic bidding to target audiences based on video content context, ensuring brand safety and optimized campaign performance.

Ed.ai is an AI assistant that pre-grades assignments in half the time, identifies each student's learning gaps, and generates personalized remediation, deployed in secondary schools across France and the US.
Ekinops is a provider of open and interoperable telecommunications solutions, offering optical transport, access, and software-defined technologies to empower networks worldwide.
Elba is the modern security hub for modern teams. With their plug-and-play solution, they detect security issues and guide the end-users on how to fix them.
ELDIM specializes in the design and manufacturing of optical measurement systems, with a focus on evaluating the viewing angle performance of displays and other optical components.

Elum Energy is an AI-driven energy management platform that provides controllers and software to monitor and optimize the energy mix of solar power plants and microgrids, improving efficiency, reliability, and sustainability.

Founded in 2021 by Fabien Watrelot, Ensweet is a French MedTech company specializing in remote cardiac rehabilitation. Its hybrid solution, based on digital tools and expert human support, allows cardiac patients to access a home-based care program, in close collaboration with their medical team. Ensweet raised €3M in Seed funding in May 2025, in a round led by Mutuelles Impact, alongside AG2R LA MONDIALE, Angels Santé, Nord France Amorçage (NFA), 50 Partners, Finovam 2, and makesense, and several business angels specializing in health.

Epigene Labs develops advanced epigenetic and genomics-driven tools to accelerate precision drug discovery in oncology. By leveraging insights into gene expression and regulation, the company enables the design of targeted therapies tailored to individual cancer profiles.

Epoca is a mission-driven company that develops a hybrid technological and human solution for remote home monitoring of elderly patients with complex multiple pathologies, either over the long term or temporarily during acute phases.

Eptica Lingway provides AI-powered recruitment and talent management solutions built on a proprietary HR semantic dictionary of over one million terms. Its software suite supports HR professionals in sourcing, matching, and managing talent through advanced semantic search, predictive recruitment, and data normalization across multiple systems.

ErgoSanté designs and manufactures custom ergonomic solutions to improve workplace health, safety, and inclusion. Its product range includes adaptive office furniture for both disabled and able-bodied employees, as well as industrial exoskeletons that help prevent musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs) through physical support and strain reduction.
Estuaire is a carbon accounting platform tailored to the aviation industry, leveraging detailed flight data to assess environmental impact and simulate effective decarbonization strategies.

Ethik-IA is the leading operator of human oversight for AI in healthcare. The company provides guidance to both users and developers of health-related AI solutions, offering support in implementing compliance validation processes aligned with the upcoming European AI Act.
Etsy is a global online marketplace where individuals can buy and sell handmade, vintage, and unique goods, fostering a community of creative entrepreneurs and shoppers.

Evaneos is a travel marketplace that connects travelers with local travel agents around the world to design unique, tailor-made multi-day trips, promoting more authentic and sustainable travel experiences.
Emulation & Verification Engineering (EVE) provides hardware-assisted solutions for the verification of complex integrated circuits (i.e. System-on-Chips or SoC).
Fidor Bank was a digital bank based in Germany, known for its innovative approach to banking services.

Flink makes it easier to order groceries from your phone and receive them 15 minutes later. The startup wants to differentiate itself with a full-stack approach and operates its own micro-fulfillment centers.

getinside is a French technology platform connecting brands with curated creator communities to design and execute performance-driven marketing campaigns. It enables companies to activate authentic customer voices at scale, managing everything from campaign setup to performance tracking. By combining marketplace dynamics with SaaS tools, Getinside helps brands drive measurable acquisition and engagement through trusted digital channels.
Gitti is a beauty brand specializing in innovative, sustainable, and vegan nail polish products, promoting eco-friendly beauty choices for consumers.

Gladia is an AI software provider offering advanced speech-to-text transcription, translation, and audio intelligence through asynchronous and real-time APIs, enabling accurate and efficient voice data processing at scale.

Gleamer develops AI-powered solutions for radiology, serving as a clinical companion to help radiologists detect lesions such as bone fractures and lung nodules on X-ray images, improving diagnostic accuracy and workflow efficiency.

Goodays offers a customer engagement platform that helps businesses manage in-store and online interactions in real time. Its software suite enhances customer satisfaction and loyalty through personalized communication and feedback management.

Green Fusion provides AI-driven energy optimization solutions that integrate renewable energy sources to support the decarbonization of residential real estate, helping businesses and communities reduce consumption and enhance sustainability.
Greenly offers a digital platform for carbon accounting, helping companies measure, reduce, and offset their carbon emissions to achieve sustainability goals.

HelloBetter develops digital medical devices for mental health, offering a catalog of clinically validated programs targeting conditions such as insomnia, depression, stress, and anxiety. Designed to be prescribed by healthcare professionals, these solutions support patients through evidence-based, digital therapeutic interventions.

Homaio is a climate-focused investment platform that enables individuals to invest in carbon assets designed for both financial returns and environmental impact. With a singular focus on reducing CO₂ emissions, Homaio offers access to regulated carbon markets, empowering investors to fight climate change while building a high-impact portfolio.

Homerez is a property management platform for vacation rentals that simplifies the booking process for owners by managing listing creation, multiposting across rental sites, and handling bookings and payments — all through a centralized solution designed to maximize occupancy and ease operations.
Developer of industrial inkjet printing solutions for high-speed commercial, security, and packaging applications.

IMPLICITY developed a remote monitoring platform for patients with connected pacemakers and defibrillators. Designed for cardiologists and healthcare professionals, it automates remote monitoring of their patients. An artificial intelligence module determines the criticality of each alert considering the medical context of the patient.

Intent Technologies offers a cloud platform that connects all stakeholders in the real estate sector—managers, service providers, software, and connected objects—to enhance the efficiency and attractiveness of buildings and urban areas.

IPTEGO GmbH develops software and hardware appliances for the Voice over IP (VoIP) industry, specializing in VoIP gateways and network solutions that enhance communication infrastructure and interoperability, acquired by Acme Packet then by Oracle.

Itrs Automation developed software to improve productivity and code quality in industrial automation and embedded systems. Its solutions supported more efficient and reliable development processes and were ultimately acquired by Schneider Electric.

Jobvalley is Germany’s leading digital platform and temporary job agency for students and graduates, connecting them with flexible work opportunities and supporting their transition from education to professional life.

JOIN has developed a software to help brands and content creators produce stories that can be published across all channels, from websites to social media platforms. At XAnge, we are convinced that web pages will progressively jump into the stories format in the coming years, as it is a powerful way to showcase creators’ contents, drive engagement or create a brand experience.

Kiplin is a digital health company that develops mobile games to promote physical activity and prevent chronic diseases through gamification. By identifying at-risk populations, Kiplin offers personalized prevention programs—including a subscription-based corporate service (“UP”) and in-person events—designed to drive long-term behavior change and improve health outcomes.
KissKissBankBank is a crowdfunding platform that enables individuals and organizations to finance creative and entrepreneurial projects through public contributions.

Knowunity is the digital learning companion for students around the world. Founded in 2020, the platform combines personalized AI technology with student-generated content to make learning simpler, more engaging, and more successful. With over 6 million monthly users across 15+ countries, Knowunity is one of the fastest-growing educational platforms in the world.

Known internationally as The Food Assembly, this platform is a food marketplace that connects consumers directly with local farmers and producers, enabling the purchase of fresh, sustainable products through a software-supported model.
Le Collectionist offers luxury villa and chalet rentals in various destinations, providing personalized services and unique experiences for travelers seeking high-end accommodations.
Le Fourgon is a delivery service specializing in beverages and other products in reusable containers, promoting zero-waste consumption by collecting and reusing packaging.
Ledger provides top notch security to critical digital assets for consumers, institutional investors and industrial companies

LegalPlace is a Legal-as-a-Service platform for small businesses, offering digital solutions for company formation, accounting, domiciliation, and automated legal document generation—including employment contracts, lease agreements, and shareholder pacts.
Letsmeet is a SaaS company in the productivity vertical helping employees to organize seamlessly the set up of meetings.

Lifeaz develops innovative health solutions to improve emergency response, including "Clark," a connected and user-friendly defibrillator designed for home and SME use. The company also offers training tools to promote life-saving skills and accelerate the adoption of defibrillators among the general public

With Lydia’s 100% mobile and digital current account, you can send money instantly to a relative using their phone number. You can also spend money abroad without any fee on payments nor withdrawals. The company now has more than 4 million users

Lyv develops a Class I digital medical device designed to support individuals living with endometriosis. The solution helps patients self-manage their symptoms alongside standard medical care, with the goal of improving their quality of life through personalized digital support.

MakeMeReach is a social media advertising platform that helps businesses optimize and automate their online marketing campaigns across multiple social networks using data-driven strategies. Now part of Paragone, the platform continues to empower marketers with advanced tools for cross-channel campaign management and performance optimization.

Mdoloris Medical Systems develops continuous, non-invasive monitoring solutions to assess pain and comfort levels in both conscious and unconscious patients. Its technology enhances anesthesia management and improves overall patient care during surgical and critical care procedures.

MeinAuto.de is an online automotive platform that allows customers to configure, finance, and purchase new and used cars from various brands at competitive prices, offering a seamless digital experience across the car buying journey.
Microdon provides innovative solutions for corporate social responsibility, including platforms that facilitate employee and customer engagement in charitable giving and volunteering.
mindDay reinvents mental wellness by combining human guidance, digital programs and science to provide immediate and personalized support to anyone.
Mirsense develops advanced gas sensors based on quantum cascade laser (QCL) technology, enabling high-precision detection and analysis for industrial, defense, and security applications.

Founded in 2007, Mister Spex is a multi-award-winning company that has become the leading digital native omnichannel opticial brand in Europe. The company has grown from a pure online player into a successful omnichannel optician with more than five million customers and more than 40 physical retail stores in Germany, Austria and Sweden. The focus of Mister Spex is to make eyewear purchase for customers an easy, transparent and fun shopping experience by combining a comprehensive and varied range of high-quality products with optician expertise and services.

Naskeo specializes in designing, constructing, and operating anaerobic digestion plants that convert organic waste into renewable energy, contributing to sustainable waste management and energy production.

Nelson Mobility is a B2B software platform that helps companies electrify their corporate vehicle fleets. Founded in 2022, it aggregates companies' existing mobility data — fuel card transactions, driver mileage, home locations — and cross-references them with charging infrastructure and vehicle range data to generate automatically updated, driver-level electrification roadmaps. Its approach allows fleet managers to identify conversion-ready drivers and meet French decarbonization mandates without costly manual audits.

Neobrain is an AI-powered SaaS platform for strategic talent management, enabling organizations to identify internal skills, monitor performance, support upskilling, and drive internal mobility. Its solution includes four core modules: skill mapping via AI, performance tracking, personalized learning aligned with employee aspirations, and AI-based internal mobility planning.

Neolane was a French software company specializing in cross-channel campaign management and marketing automation. Its platform enabled brands to orchestrate personalized marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, and more, all from a unified interface. In 2013, Neolane was acquired by Adobe to enhance the Adobe Marketing Cloud (now Adobe Experience Cloud), strengthening its capabilities in data-driven and real-time campaign execution.

Netasq was a French cybersecurity company specializing in unified network security appliances. It provided integrated firewall, intrusion prevention (IPS), and VPN technologies tailored for businesses and public sector organizations. Netasq’s solutions later became Stormshield’s next-generation network security offerings following its fusion with Arkoon.

News Republic was a personalized news platform that used AI technology to deliver relevant, real-time content tailored to each user’s interests. Now as part of ByteDance, it leverages the group’s advanced content recommendation infrastructure and is available globally alongside products like TikTok and TopBuzz.

Odoo offers a comprehensive open-source suite of business applications—ranging from CRM and accounting to e-commerce, inventory, and project management—providing a flexible cloud ERP solution tailored for SMEs of all sizes.

Omie is a purpose-driven food brand delivering low-carbon, organic dry products co-developed with local producers. Committed to regenerative agriculture, Omie ensures full transparency on ingredient sourcing and fair compensation, supporting both healthy ecosystems and sustainable farming practices.

OneUp is a cloud-based ERP solution for small and medium-sized businesses, offering integrated tools for accounting automation, invoicing, bookkeeping, and inventory management to streamline operations and improve financial visibility.
Ouihelp provides personalized home care services for seniors in France, offering tailored support to improve their quality of life and maintain autonomy at home.
Peerby is a peer-to-peer marketplace that enables individuals to borrow or rent items from neighbors, promoting a circular economy and reducing unnecessary consumption through local sharing.

Pina Earth is a SaaS company that enables forest owners to access the voluntary carbon market by digitizing the certification process using remote sensing and AI. It offers CO₂ certificates from German forests, supporting the transition from vulnerable monocultures to climate-resilient mixed forests to boost carbon sequestration and biodiversity.

Planetary builds, owns, and operates a global network of fully integrated fermentation facilities to scale sustainable biomanufacturing. Focused on biomass and precision fermentation, the company enables the production of bio-based products across various industries by expanding global bioprocessing capacity.
Pony enables cities to offer sustainable and decentralized micro-mobility solutions through a unique shared ownership model, fostering local engagement and reducing operational costs.

Popsink is a no-code platform for real-time data integration, enabling business users to build non-intrusive, incremental data pipelines and transform live data streams across systems—without relying on engineering resources.
PrestaShop is an efficient and innovative e-commerce solution with all the features companies need to create an online store and grow their business.

Procuros is an AI-native B2B connectivity platform that automates supply chains between suppliers and retailers. By replacing legacy EDI, PDFs and manual data entry with a single connection to all trade partners, Procuros delivers clean, validated order, logistics and invoice data straight into companies' ERP systems, paving the way for autonomous B2B commerce.

Promus is a digital wholesaler that connects local producers directly with restaurants through a streamlined distribution platform. By eliminating unnecessary intermediaries, Promus aims to bring farmers back to the center of the food chain and promote more transparent, sustainable sourcing in the restaurant industry.

Qubit Pharmaceuticals is a physics-driven drug discovery company that leverages quantum physics, advanced simulation software, and AI-enhanced medicinal chemistry to develop novel drug candidates and innovative mechanisms of action targeting complex diseases.

Raisin is a fintech company that operates an online marketplace for savings and investment products, giving consumers access to competitive interest rates and financial offerings from banks across Europe.
Reelevant is a real-time email targeting platform that enables businesses to send dynamic, personalized, and context-aware emails, improving customer engagement and boosting conversion rates.

Reflect is a people analytics platform specifically designed for HR teams, enabling them to centralize and monitor all key workforce indicators in one place. The tool helps organizations make data-driven decisions to support talent management, employee engagement, and HR strategy.
Companies, DAOs, and Freelancers use Request to easily manage crypto invoices, salaries, and expenses in a fast, non-custodial, and compliant way.

ResidSocial is a solidarity housing provider that acquires run-down social hotels to transform them into dignified residential facilities, enabling vulnerable families referred by social services to rebuild their lives through stable housing and a comprehensive network of support programs.

Roctool specializes in heat-and-cool molding technologies using induction, offering advanced materials processing solutions that improve manufacturing efficiency and product quality across industries such as automotive, electronics, and consumer goods.

ROOF is a coliving platform that provides fully furnished shared flats for students and young professionals. Designed to offer comfort, affordability, and a strong sense of community, ROOF simplifies urban living through all-inclusive services and flexible rental terms in major French cities.
RunMyProcess offers a low-code platform that enables organizations to automate, integrate, and streamline business processes, facilitating digital transformation and operational efficiency.

SamanTree Medical provides advanced intraoperative imaging solutions to support cancer surgery. Its Histolog® Scanner enables near real-time visualization of resection margins on fresh tissue, helping surgeons assess tumor removal and accelerating pathological verification during procedures.

Saporo is a Swiss cybersecurity company specializing in internal attack surface management. Its platform helps organizations anticipate and prevent cyberattacks by identifying, prioritizing, and mitigating risks linked to identities, permissions, and system configurations.

Sculpteo is an online 3D printing service that offers digital manufacturing solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to produce prototypes and end-use products using a variety of materials and technologies.

Sensorberg provides intelligent access control and IoT infrastructure software for PropTech environments, digitizing and automating access to commercial real estate and self-storage facilities through integrated hardware and software solutions.

Shine is a French neobank and financial co-pilot app designed for freelancers and small businesses. It combines banking services with administrative support, offering tools for managing finances, invoicing, and legal paperwork—all in one platform.
Shopmium is a mobile application that provides users with exclusive offers and cashback deals on everyday products, enhancing shopping experiences and savings.

Sidetrade provides an AI-powered platform that optimizes the entire order-to-cash process, helping businesses accelerate cash flow, reduce churn, and unlock value from customer relationships. Its next-generation AI, Aimie, leverages a proprietary global database of payment behaviors to deliver predictive insights and intelligent automation—enhancing decision-making, streamlining collections, and improving collaboration between finance and sales teams.
Silvr provides revenue-based financing solutions for digital entrepreneurs, offering fast and flexible funding without equity dilution to support business growth.
Sinequa is a leader in AI-powered enterprise search, providing organizations with a platform to access and analyze vast amounts of data, enhancing decision-making and innovation.

Sirona Technologies is a climate tech company developing Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology to remove CO₂ from the atmosphere, contributing to the fight against climate change through scalable carbon removal solutions.

Skello was created in 2016 with a simple but ambitious mission: to make life easier for all physical retailers by revamping the way they worjk with their teams. All of this through an intelligent planning and staff management tool.

Smart Tribune provides AI-powered selfcare solutions that help large enterprises and high-traffic websites enhance customer satisfaction while reducing support costs. Through dynamic FAQs, chatbots, personalized help widgets, and community forums, the platform empowers users to find fast, effective answers and reduces level 1 support inquiries.

Stane supports healthcare entrepreneurs in the creation and operation of primary care centers across France. Capitalizing on the rapid development of multidisciplinary health centers (MSPs) as alternatives to hospitals and isolated private practices, Stane aims to build France’s leading network for integrated urban healthcare. Its mission is to meet public health challenges while addressing the needs of all healthcare stakeholders.
Building high-quality human data to help AI models better understand nuance and judgment.

SunaCare is a German company that offers an online platform for 24-hour in-home elderly care, connecting families with qualified caregivers to provide personalized support and improve the well-being and autonomy of seniors.

SurgAR is a French MedTech startup, spun out from CHU Clermont-Ferrand and the EnCoV (Endoscopy and Computer Vision) research group. It develops AI- and AR-powered software to support minimally invasive surgery. By providing surgeons with augmented intraoperative views that highlight tumors and masses in real time, SurgAR enhances surgical planning, navigation, and decision-making—ultimately improving precision, reducing complications, and lowering reintervention rates.

Sweagle is a SaaS platform for Configuration Data Management (CDM) of enterprise applications, enabling better visibility, control, and automation of complex configuration data. Acquired by ServiceNow, Sweagle strengthens IT operations management by reducing configuration-related risks and improving system reliability.

Synapse Medicine is an AI-powered platform that supports healthcare professionals in making safe and effective prescribing decisions. By providing reliable, up-to-date drug information and clinical decision support, it integrates seamlessly with electronic health records and e-prescription tools to enhance medication safety.

Sêmeia builds MedicWise, a certified remote patient monitoring platform enabling care teams to track chronic disease patients in real time, with automatic collection of biological data integrated into existing hospital systems. Its NephroWise solution has led the nephrology telemonitoring market in France for seven years, used by over 350 care teams to monitor 15,000 patients.
TEEPTRAK offers a set of all-in-one, autonomous and external solutions for monitoring the performance of any production equipment, physical values or a set of manual tasks.

Tomorro is a legal tech company that leverages artificial intelligence to automate and streamline contract management. Designed to free businesses from the burdens of manual legal processes, the platform enables legal and operational teams to focus on innovation and strategy. By combining human expertise with AI, Tomorro is shaping the future of smarter, more agile contract workflows.

Travador is a travel platform specializing in curated and affordable short vacation packages, including wellness retreats, weekend getaways, and adventure trips. It combines hotel stays with entertainment options to deliver unique travel experiences at competitive prices.

TreeFrog Therapeutics is a stem cell company that will enable millions of patients to access the medical revolution of cell therapies by overcoming current critical manufacturing issues. TreeFrog Therapeutics has developed C-Stem® : a proprietary technology platform that provides an end to end 3D scalable solution that will dramatically reduce treatment costs. Through strategic partnership and co-developments, TreeFrog Therapeutics will help cell therapy players to secure cell production and quality, fasten clinical development and facilitate market access

UBAQ develops quality management and regulatory affairs software tailored to the pharmaceutical, medical device, and cosmetics industries. Its solutions automate compliance workflows, helping companies save time and meet stringent industry standards efficiently.

Valuecase enables B2B sales teams to differentiate from their competition and systemise a buyer-centric digital sales process. With Valuecase customer-facing teams create digital spaces that take their buyers by hand from first call over onboarding to customer success. Valuecase spaces include all relevant information, promote collaboration, and are highly customizable. And creating them is as easy as writing an e-mail.

Vertical Compute is a European deep-tech semiconductor startup developing next-generation memory technologies to accelerate data-intensive workloads such as generative AI. By bringing data closer to computation, the company aims to achieve unmatched speed and efficiency through a universal memory solution that combines the best of DRAM and SRAM.

Vertuoza is a vertical ERP platform tailored for small and medium-sized construction companies. It helps manage projects, budgets, and teams efficiently, enhancing productivity, profitability, and operational control across construction workflows.

Vianova is a mobility intelligence platform that aggregates data from shared mobility, on-demand transport, public transit, automotive, smart parking, EV charging, and urban logistics. It provides cities and mobility operators with actionable insights to manage shared mobility, foster modal shifts toward sustainable transport, and enable transparent collaboration between public and private stakeholders.

VSORA is a French fabless semiconductor company, founded in Paris in 2015, that designs ultra-high-performance AI inference chips for data centers. Its flagship product, Jotunn8, delivers 3,200 Tflops of compute power while using 50% less power than leading market chips, tackling the "memory wall" bottleneck that limits traditional processors.

Wandercraft develops Atalante X, a hands-free, self-balancing exoskeleton designed for individuals with paraplegia, tetraplegia, or recovering from stroke. It enables patients to stand and walk during rehabilitation, supporting mobility restoration and clinical progress.
Webedia is a global media-tech company specializing in online entertainment, partnering with creators, producers, and brands to produce and distribute content across various digital platforms.

Welcome to the Jungle is a comprehensive employment and employer branding platform that helps companies attract talent through customized career pages, an ATS, and rich media content. It also supports job seekers with job listings, company profiles, and career resources to guide their professional journeys.

Winncare is one of Europe’s leading providers of medical equipment, including medical beds, anti-pressure sore mattresses, and patient transfer devices for elderly, dependent, and disabled individuals. This investment is part of the Mutuelles Impact Large Cap fund pocket.

Worklife is an integrated platform for managing employee benefits, combining a unique payment card and mobile app to centralize and simplify access to perks such as childcare, mobility, and well-being services. It operates as both a B2C and B2B2C marketplace, particularly in the childcare space, enhancing employee engagement and streamlining HR processes.
Workmotion is a Human Resource SaaS solution which enables the hiring of employees globally without requiring local subsidiaries.

Zenchef is a SaaS one-stop-shop marketing and management suite for restaurants, combining reservation booking, CRM, and loyalty tools. It helps restaurants streamline operations, enhance customer relationships, and deliver better guest experiences through a unified digital platform.
